title: Dissolution of Monitor RFPD Contingent Other Measures
ballot_label: Caption: Dissolution of Monitor RFPD Contingent Other Measures (Question and summary not retrievable; see collection_notes.)
summary: Would dissolve the Monitor Rural Fire Protection District as part of a three-measure consolidation with the Mt. Angel Fire District. Per the official explanatory statements for the related Marion County measures, the new Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District forms only if voters approve all three: formation (24-529) and dissolution of each existing district (24-526 and this measure). The new district would have a $1.97 per $1,000 permanent tax rate.
yes_means: A yes vote approves dissolving the Monitor Rural Fire Protection District, effective only if the related formation and Mt. Angel Fire District dissolution measures also pass.
no_means: A no vote rejects dissolution; the Monitor Rural Fire Protection District would continue to operate.
fiscal_impact: Per the official explanatory statement for related Measure 24-529: the new district's permanent tax rate would be $1.97 per $1,000 of assessed value, 'higher than the existing permanent tax rate of each district'; assets and reserves of the dissolving districts transfer to the new district.
gaps: No YES argument found in T1/T3 sources (pamphlet unreadable; Woodburn Independent Sept 6, 2026 article quotes no supporters; Marion BOC July 27, 2026 minutes record seven public commenters without their content).
No NO argument found in T1/T3 sources (same searches).
collection_notes: yes_means/no_means: Oregon local ballot titles carry no official result-of-vote statement; these are neutral one-sentence descriptions written by the collector strictly from the official ballot question/summary. County voters' pamphlet (https://docs.clackamas.us/documents/drupal/03f4f9db-a1ab-4a1f-9ce1-16059d49a513) lists this measure in its index, but WebFetch text extraction ends at page C-33 (~117k chars), before the measure section, so the pamphlet's explanatory statement and any filed arguments could not be read. The county ballot-title PDF linked from the election page returned only the multilingual accommodations notice (likely an image scan). Contingency, from official text: the explanatory statement for Measure 24-529 (Formation of Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District; posted on docs.clackamas.us) says 'The new district will become operational only if all three related measures are approved by voters: formation of the new district and dissolution of each existing district.' and 'If all three measures are not adopted, the Mt. Angel-Monitor Fire District would not be formed, the two existing districts would continue to operate separately under their current tax rates'. Marion's explanatory statement for 24-526 (Mt. Angel Fire dissolution) says 'This measure will take effect only if all three related measures are approved by voters'. The 3-640 ballot title itself was not readable (county PDF is image-only), so 3-640's own wording of the contingency is unverified; the description relies on the two related official statements. Measures 24-526 and 24-529 do not name 3-640 by number in the text retrieved. If approved, new district would form January 1, 2027. full_text_url points to the 24-529 explanatory statement as the best readable official description. Inventory caption matches county page.
